input.title: Need the map's location to write alt text for the contact page map
input.rationale: The on contact.html has no alt attribute. Based on the file name and where it sits under "Contact us", it's probably a location map, and that would usually carry information. But the rendered image is just a small solid pink square with no visible map, text or address. Nothing else in the repo mentions the address either: a search for "map.png" only finds this line, and a search for "address" finds nothing. I can't write accurate alt text without knowing what location the map shows, and I can't confirm whether the image is decorative. So I'm not guessing.
